Inna mā tūʿadūna laʾātiw wamā antum bimuʿjizīn
Qul yāqawmiʿmalū ʿalā makānatikum innī ʿāmil, fasawfa taʿlamūna man takūnu lahū ʿāqibatud-dār, innahū lā yufliḥuẓ-ẓālimūn

Wajaʿalū lillāhi mimmā dharaʾa minal-ḥarthi wal-anʿāmi naṣīban faqālū hādhā lillāhi bizaʿmihim wahādhā lishurakāʾinā, famā kāna lishurakāʾihim falā yaṣilu ilallāh, wamā kāna lillāhi fahuwa yaṣilu ilā shurakāʾihim, sāʾa mā yaḥkumūn
Wakadhālika zayyana likathīrim minal-mushrikīna qatla awlādihim shurakāʾuhum liyurdūhum waliyalbisū ʿalayhim dīnahum, walaw shāʾallāhu mā faʿalūhu fadharhum wamā yaftarūn
Waqālū hādhihī anʿāmuw waḥarthun ḥijrul lā yaṭʿamuhā illā man nashāʾu bizaʿmihim waʾanʿāmun ḥurrimat ẓuhūruhā waʾanʿāmul lā yadhkurūnasmallāhi ʿalayhaftirāʾan ʿalayh, sayajzīhim bimā kānū yaftarūn
Waqālū mā fī buṭūni hādhihil-anʿāmi khāliṣatul lidhukūrinā wamuḥarramun ʿalā azwājinā, waʾiy yakum maytatan fahum fīhi shurakāʾ, sayajzīhim waṣfahum, innahū ḥakīmun ʿalīm
Qad khasiral-ladhīna qatalū awlādahum safaham bighayri ʿilmiw waḥarramū mā razaqahumullāhuftirāʾan ʿalallāh, qad ḍallū wamā kānū muhtadīn

Wahuwal-ladhī anshaʾa jannātim maʿrūshātiw waghayra maʿrūshātiw wan-nakhla waz-zarʿa mukhtalifan ukuluhū waz-zaytūna war-rummāna mutashābihaw waghayra mutashābih, kulū min thamarihī idhā athmara waʾātū ḥaqqahū yawma ḥaṣādih, walā tusrifū, innahū lā yuḥibbul-musrifīn
Waminal-anʿāmi ḥamūlataw wafarshā, kulū mimmā razaqakumullāhu walā tattabiʿū khuṭuwātish-shayṭān, innahū lakum ʿaduwwum mubīn
Thamāniyata azwāj, minaḍ-ḍaʾnithnayni waminal-maʿzithnayn, qul ādh-dhakarayni ḥarrama amil-unthayayni ammashtamalat ʿalayhi arḥāmul-unthayayn, nabbiʾūnī biʿilmin in kuntum ṣādiqīn

Waminal-ibilithnayni waminal-baqarithnayn, qul ādh-dhakarayni ḥarrama amil-unthayayni ammashtamalat ʿalayhi arḥāmul-unthayayn, am kuntum shuhadāʾa idh waṣṣākumullāhu bihādhā, faman aẓlamu mimmaniftarā ʿalallāhi kadhibal liyuḍillan-nāsa bighayri ʿilm, innallāha lā yahdil-qawmaẓ-ẓālimīn

Qul lā ajidu fī mā ūḥiya ilayya muḥarraman ʿalā ṭāʿimiy yaṭʿamuhū illā ay yakūna maytatan aw damam masfūḥan aw laḥma khinzīrin faʾinnahū rijsun aw fisqan uhilla lighayrillāhi bih, famaniḍṭurra ghayra bāghiw walā ʿādin faʾinna rabbaka ghafūrur raḥīm

Waʿalal-ladhīna hādū ḥarramnā kulla dhī ẓufur, waminal-baqari wal-ghanami ḥarramnā ʿalayhim shuḥūmahumā illā mā ḥamalat ẓuhūruhumā awil-ḥawāyā aw makhtalaṭa biʿaẓm, dhālika jazaynāhum bibaghyihim, waʾinnā laṣādiqūn
Faʾin kadhdhabūka faqur rabbukum dhū raḥmatiw wāsiʿah, walā yuraddu baʾsuhū ʿanil-qawmil-mujrimīn

Sayaqūlul-ladhīna ashrakū law shāʾallāhu mā ashraknā walā ābāʾunā walā ḥarramnā min shayʾ, kadhālika kadhdhabal-ladhīna min qablihim ḥattā dhāqū baʾsanā, qul hal ʿindakum min ʿilmin fatukhrijūhu lanā, in tattabiʿūna illaẓ-ẓanna waʾin antum illā takhruṣūn
Qul falillāhil-ḥujjatul-bālighah, falaw shāʾa lahadākum ajmaʿīn

Qul halumma shuhadāʾakumul-ladhīna yashhadūna annallāha ḥarrama hādhā, faʾin shahidū falā tashhad maʿahum, walā tattabiʿ ahwāʾal-ladhīna kadhdhabū biʾāyātinā wal-ladhīna lā yuʾminūna bil-ākhirati wahum birabbihim yaʿdilūn

Qul taʿālaw atlu mā ḥarrama rabbukum ʿalaykum allā tushrikū bihī shayʾaw wabil-wālidayni iḥsānā, walā taqtulū awlādakum min imlāq, naḥnu narzuqukum waʾiyyāhum, walā taqrabul-fawāḥisha mā ẓahara minhā wamā baṭan, walā taqtulun-nafsal-latī ḥarramallāhu illā bil-ḥaqq, dhālikum waṣṣākum bihī laʿallakum taʿqilūn

Walā taqrabū mālal-yatīmi illā bil-latī hiya aḥsanu ḥattā yablugha ashuddah, waʾawful-kayla wal-mīzāna bil-qisṭ, lā nukallifu nafsan illā wusʿahā, waʾidhā qultum faʿdilū walaw kāna dhā qurbā, wabiʿahdillāhi awfū, dhālikum waṣṣākum bihī laʿallakum tadhakkarūn
Waʾanna hādhā ṣirāṭī mustaqīman fattabiʿūh, walā tattabiʿus-subula fatafarraqa bikum ʿan sabīlih, dhālikum waṣṣākum bihī laʿallakum tattaqūn
Thumma ātaynā mūsal-kitāba tamāman ʿalal-ladhī aḥsana watafṣīlal likulli shayʾiw wahudaw waraḥmatal laʿallahum biliqāʾi rabbihim yuʾminūn
Wahādhā kitābun anzalnāhu mubārakun fattabiʿūhu wattaqū laʿallakum turḥamūn
An taqūlū innamā unzilal-kitābu ʿalā ṭāʾifatayni min qablinā, waʾin kunnā ʿan dirāsatihim laghāfilīn

Aw taqūlū law annā unzila ʿalaynal-kitābu lakunnā ahdā minhum, faqad jāʾakum bayyinatum mir rabbikum wahudaw waraḥmah, faman aẓlamu mimman kadhdhaba biʾāyātillāhi waṣadafa ʿanhā, sanajzil-ladhīna yaṣdifūna ʿan āyātinā sūʾal-ʿadhābi bimā kānū yaṣdifūn

Hal yanẓurūna illā an taʾtiyahumul-malāʾikatu aw yaʾtiya rabbuka aw yaʾtiya baʿḍu āyāti rabbik, yawma yaʾtī baʿḍu āyāti rabbika lā yanfaʿu nafsan īmānuhā lam takun āmanat min qablu aw kasabat fī īmānihā khayrā, qulintaẓirū innā muntaẓirūn
Innal-ladhīna farraqū dīnahum wakānū shiyaʿal lasta minhum fī shayʾ, innamā amruhum ilallāhi thumma yunabbiʾuhum bimā kānū yafʿalūn
Man jāʾa bil-ḥasanati falahū ʿashru amthālihā, waman jāʾa bis-sayyiʾati falā yujzā illā mithlahā wahum lā yuẓlamūn
Qul innanī hadānī rabbī ilā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm, dīnan qiyamam millata ibrāhīma ḥanīfā, wamā kāna minal-mushrikīn
Qul inna ṣalātī wanusukī wamaḥyāya wamamātī lillāhi rabbil-ʿālamīn
Lā sharīka lah, wabidhālika umirtu waʾana awwalul-muslimīn

Qul aghayrallāhi abghī rabbaw wahuwa rabbu kulli shayʾ, walā taksibu kullu nafsin illā ʿalayhā, walā taziru wāziratuw wizra ukhrā, thumma ilā rabbikum marjiʿukum fayunabbiʾukum bimā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūn
Wahuwal-ladhī jaʿalakum khalāʾifal-arḍi warafaʿa baʿḍakum fawqa baʿḍin darajātil liyabluwakum fī mā ātākum, inna rabbaka sarīʿul-ʿiqāb, waʾinnahū laghafūrur raḥīm
